Loadouts are premade, map is Castle...|In-game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Classic Castle''' was the fifth and final [[Maps|map]] of [[The Classic Event]]. It has been made available again through the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Triumphing this map rewarded the player with {{Token|1}}, alongside the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} [[Scout]] skin and the [[Classic Nametag]]. There was also {{Tix|1}} on the map, which could be found in the upper left corner of the map. This map has a premade loadout. It consists of the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} [[Golden Scout]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]]. Skins could not be applied to these towers without the use of bugs, though this is not the case in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. This map had four modifiers. The first was [[Enemies Beta]], which changes the appearance of some enemies. The second was [[Classic Roblox]], which activated the next two modifiers on the map. The third modifier was [[Classic Oof]], which made enemies play the old Roblox death sound. The fourth was [[Retro Death]], which made enemies collapse into multiple pieces upon death. When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only [[Classic Oof]] and [[Retro Death]] are applied. ==Design & Path== '''Classic Castle''' takes place in a castle surrounded by hills and castle walls. The terrain is grassy, with multiple hills placed on the map. There are multiple houses on the maps, alongside a black tower in the middle. The black path starts and ends at a medieval castle gate. The path itself rotates around a large hill with a tower on it. The map slowly got corrupted, turning parts of the map into a dark black color, and making other objects float in the sky. By Wave 2, parts of the map exploded. By Wave 6, rain begin to fall down onto the map. By Wave 7, yellow lightning bolts struck down onto the map. By Wave 8, the skybox was changed to a red and black pattern that constantly turned. This no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Classic Castle}} ==Event Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|100}} ÷ (1 + [(14 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.3 |({{Exp|30}} ÷ (1 + [(14 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.3 |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which could be obtained when playing this map, which may have had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Premium 5 |image = PremiumBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Token|1}} }} {{Badge |title = Tix 5 |image = TixBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Tix|1}} }} ==Wave Structure== Wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|100}} + (Waves Completed × {{Money|1,500}})^0.99 At Waves 11 and 13, the wave bonus is {{Money|200,000}}. Wave clear bonus is 35% of the wave bonus. '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *The [[Golden Scout]] and [[Engineer]] can be clear out enemies that appear early on quite easily. **Using the [[Engineer]] may be more beneficial, as it is usable throughout the entire match, instead of just the early game. *The [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]] are all useful later on, due to their high DPS. **The [[Ranger]] can be especially useful do its stun immunity and high range, allowing it to easily cover most of the map. **The [[Accelerator]] may be less useful due to it being able to be stunned and there not having many good ground spots. *You may use the [[Mortar]] to clear out early hordes, though you should not use it later on when you get a lot of cash. *It is recommended to not skip waves 11 and 13 and try to kill all the enemies that spawn, because you get a huge amount of wave clear bonus to get multiple expensive towers in your loadout. ==Trivia== *This map is based on [[Castle]], an old and now removed map. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Classic Castle''' added. **{{Bug}} Towers can have other skins if the tower is equipped in the lobby. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Classic Castle''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Classic Castle''' re-added, to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode only. **{{Bug}} Wave structure turns into regular modes after the final wave. **{{Bug}} {{Tix|}} no longer spins. **{{Bug}} Map no longer corrupts. **{{Bug}} [[1x1x1x1]] no longer has a model. {{TheClassicMaps|[[Classic Island Chaos]]|Mission 4|[[Classic Castle]]|Mission 5|End|N/A}} {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Sandbox Only Maps]]
